title: Skorzeny shown a demonstration of the Bell craft

tellings.quote: autot scores Zi, who at that time was the master of psychological warfare and special operations, >> shows up to the SCOD works and supposedly he's given a demonstration of this thing

plain: In 1944 Otto Skorzeny, whom the teller calls Nazi Germany's master of psychological warfare and special operations, came to the Skoda Works, a large arms factory, and was supposedly given a demonstration of the Bell, a craft said to have been built in a secret Nazi programme. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, with a "supposedly" and no named source. If true, it would put a working Nazi craft before senior commanders near the war's end.
